utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Oren, I'm all set to help out on Saturday. Need me to bring my toolbox or anything else?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Toolbox? For the repair drive? Oh, right! Yes, that might be helpful. I think I'm supposed to find something too, but I can't remember what.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Oren—maybe check with Quinn or Jules for the list. I can bring extra supplies if you need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I keep hearing different things about this repair drive, but it's all second-hand chatter. What's the real story, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Honestly, I'm just skimming it myself—something about fixing up the community center or maybe a potluck? All I know is I'm signing up for tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Tools? Huh, I thought it was about collecting old electronics or something. Guess I got that one wrong too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's for the community center, Oren. Now, Hana, did you get a chance to look at it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take a look at it for you, Mina—I've got a pretty good eye for those older models.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam. Have you used one of these drives before, or do you need me to walk you through it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you actually think that old USB drive is going to fix anything?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey, you never know! It's worth a shot—and even if it doesn't work, we'll have a good time fixing things up together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I'm just saying, Quinn, I've seen too many of these 'community repair drives' end up with more broken stuff than we started with.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll bring the lawnmower by on Saturday, right after breakfast. Thanks again for setting this up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's perfect, Uli! Gus is bringing his toolbox too, so we'll have everything we need to get things running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, I'll see you Saturday morning then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Pia's right—if we don't sort out parking ahead of time, it'll be chaos in that cul-de-sac. Let's assign specific spots before anyone shows up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, speaking of sorting things out, did you hear Kira's been poking fun at my USB drive idea? She thinks it's nothing but a paperclip miracle, but I've got a good feeling about it!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Tess, I'm sure your USB drive idea has merit, but let's not lose focus—we need to nail down those parking assignments first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Faye, I was just thinking about that repair drive—maybe we could head over together and finally get that old lamp of mine looked at.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, absolutely! I'm heading there around 9 a.m. after school drop-off—want to meet me at my place and we can walk over together?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds perfect. I'll be at your door at 9.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: So, Dane, let's look at the list together—I've got it right here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing, let me just pull up my notes on the homes I remember needing work from last week.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Right, I've got the map here — we've got four driveways on the list, starting with the old Morrison place on Elm.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If you're out there directing traffic, who's going to keep an eye on the tool sign-out sheet? We don't want equipment walking off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Ah, no worries! I'll have Leo at my garage—he's confirmed for 10 AM—and we can keep the sheet right by the door. Mara's even coming to help out!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, that's a relief. So we've got the tools, parking, and sign-out covered—anything else we might be forgetting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Cleo, good news — we've shifted the drive to Sunday at the community center instead!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Rosa! I'll adjust my schedule and make sure those hammers still make it there on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo! I'll add you to the Sunday list—see you then with those tools!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, do you know if Mina is around? I want to double-check before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Mina? Hmm, I think she mentioned something about running errands, but don't quote me on that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, I'll try to catch her later. Thanks for the heads up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I overheard at the store that you're collecting broken appliances—got any idea how many folks have signed up to help fix 'em?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Uli's bringing his lawnmower, couple others said they'd drop by. Should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, that's a start—maybe if we get enough folks, we could even tackle some of the bigger items like that old washing machine Mrs. Gable's been meaning to get rid of.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Oren, I'm really looking forward to that repair drive. Got my toolbox all prepped and ready to go!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! Right, that's where we... uh... fix things together? I think I've got a lamp somewhere, but it might actually be a broken clock.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds like you could use a hand sorting that out! Bring whatever you've got—I'll take a look and see if we can get it working again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I just saw you're part of the repair drive too. How's it going so far?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, you mean the one that's been sitting in a drawer for five years? You really think that old USB drive is going to fix anything?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, you never know—sometimes the oldest tech has the most character. But I was talking about the community repair event, not a literal drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe we should double-check the tool inventory before more people show up—otherwise they'll just be standing around.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good thinking, Pia. I'll grab my list and we can cross-reference what Sam's bringing too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, but let's be quick about it—if people start arriving before we're ready, it'll be chaos.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, hi Bo! Are you here about the repair drive? I've got the map of driveways that need patchwork—Dane just passed me the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Patchwork? I thought it was fixing appliances—just tell me where to sign up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, appliances? I was told it was benches and driveways. Let me check my notes—Dane definitely said patchwork.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 10 AM at Mara's garage works for me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, so we're all set for 10 AM at Mara's garage this Saturday. Don't forget to bring any broken stuff—I heard Noah's bringing a toaster, and Danny's blender is on the list too!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I'll have my tools ready. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Eli, you're just the person I was looking for! We're getting everyone together to fix up the park benches this Saturday—want to join in?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'd be glad to help, but let's make sure we have a clear schedule and know who's bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I've already got Gus bringing tools and Sam showing up at 9—so we're off to a solid start!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana! The repair drive's looking solid—Gus is bringing his toolbox and some spare parts, so we're all set. Can I count on you to spread the word to the Hillcrest folks?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check with Mina first—she mentioned a repair drive she lent me, and I want to make sure it's the same one before I start spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Right, makes sense! Mina's a key player—tell her Gus is all in with his tools, and we're good for this weekend. Let me know what she says!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Noah, you around? I need to know when we're finally doing that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Mina! Repair drive—right, that thing. Is it this weekend or next? I keep mixing it up with the park bench thing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Next Saturday, Noah. Ten in the morning at the community center. You got it straight now?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Tess, are you free Saturday morning to help with the driveways?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh sure, Dane! I was just talking to Kira about that old USB drive—she's pretty skeptical, but I think it's worth a shot. What time Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Let's aim for 9 a.m. at Opal's place — that way we can knock out a few patches before the sun gets too high.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rosa, I'm glad you're here! Are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? We've got a few folks already signed up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Mara, I'm so glad you asked! Actually, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Sunday at the community center? That's a change — thanks for telling me, I need to let everyone know!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I'm all set to haul my gear over Saturday—should I bring extra extension cords for the lawnmower?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's nice of you to think ahead. I've heard folks are bringing all sorts, so extra cords might just be a lifesaver.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll pack a couple heavy-duty ones—those lawnmowers can be finicky about power.
